issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא אִם שָׁלוֹם וֶאֱמֶת יִהְיֶה בְיָמָי' is a rhetorical statement by Hezekiah: 'For there will be peace and truth in my days' (or 'Is it not [good] if peace and truth will be in my days?'). The Vietnamese renders it as a question to Isaiah ('ông có thể nói: Có phải là điều tốt nếu...'), which incorrectly makes Hezekiah ask Isaiah whether it is good, whereas the Hebrew is Hezekiah's own reflection/affirmation about the state of his days, not a question posed to Isaiah.
